pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against opening multiple concurrent orders in the same directional vector within a 60-second window to prevent correlated stacking into sudden reversal wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory integration of an ATR-based volatility filter and order-flow imbalance score; no entry permitted unless the calculated reward-to-risk ratio on structural highs/lows mathematically exceeds 4:1.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate dynamic partial profit locking when floating profit crosses +$8.00, trailing the remaining stake to lock in baseline green while letting runners target +$15.00 to +$30.00.
